nodes.note: Jesus asks the Pharisees about the Christ and quotes the psalm’s opening address, leaving them unable to answer.
nodes.title: Jesus asks whose son the Christ is

nodes.note: While teaching in the Temple, Jesus quotes David’s words in the Holy Spirit and asks how the Christ can be both David’s Lord and son.
nodes.title: Jesus asks how the scribes call the Christ David’s son

nodes.note: Jesus quotes the psalm and asks how David’s Lord can also be David’s son.
nodes.title: Jesus asks how the Christ is David’s son

nodes.note: At the council hearing, Jesus answers the high priest and says they will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds.
nodes.title: Jesus names the Son of Man at the right hand

nodes.note: At the council hearing, Jesus answers that he is the Christ and says they will see the Son of Man at the right hand of Power and coming with heaven’s clouds.
nodes.title: Jesus answers the high priest with the right-hand saying

nodes.note: The council asks whether Jesus is the Christ and the Son of God; he says the Son of Man will sit at the right hand of God’s power.
nodes.title: Jesus speaks of the Son of Man at God’s right hand

nodes.note: Peter says David died and was buried, speaks of resurrection and exaltation, quotes the psalm, and names Jesus as Lord and Christ.
nodes.title: Peter reads David’s words beside Jesus’ resurrection

nodes.note: Before he is stoned, Stephen sees God’s glory and Jesus standing at God’s right hand, names what he sees, and calls on the Lord Jesus.
nodes.title: Stephen sees Jesus standing at God’s right hand

nodes.note: Hebrews opens with God speaking in a Son, then gathers several Scripture quotations and closes with the psalm’s right-hand address.
nodes.title: The Son is placed above the angels at God’s right hand

nodes.note: Hebrews contrasts repeated priestly service with one offering, quotes the right-hand saying, and moves toward access, hope, and meeting together.
nodes.title: One offering leads to confidence and gathered endurance

payload.title: Follow the psalm’s Lord and right hand
